statement:
The record states that the hotel to cancel for request CR-70 is Seattle, although the trip called off was Denver.
OK. I've cancelled the Denver hotel reservation.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states "the hotel to cancel for request CR-70 is Seattle, although the trip called off was Denver," identifying the field as contradicting the stated facts and cancelling Denver instead.
